scope: Disposable Oracle 8.62 Query (public/private) and project creation reversal: rollback previews, guarded deletion, owner-specific tombstones, marker-bound redo; not installed UI
checks: Public Query creation preview rolls back rows and QDM; committed creation reproduces the complete checkpoint
Stale complete Query token refuses deletion without mutation
Project creation with the Query member previews, commits and reproduces its full calibrated checkpoint
Project membership refuses Query deletion; a proposed project deletion is a rollback-preview assumption only
Nondefault project metadata refuses deletion without mutation
Project deletion preview rolls back; committed deletion removes header/members only, writes PSPROJECTDEL at PJM and keeps the Query
Public Query deletion writes the blank-owner PSQRYDEL at QDM; ordinary reads and creation refuse the tombstone
Query and project redo previews restore tombstones on rollback; redo clears each bound marker and reproduces both checkpoints
Private Query deletion writes an owner-specific marker; its redo clears only that owner
